result.one_liner: Smartsheet is a cloud-based project management and work collaboration platform for teams.

evidence.quote: Each API request requires passing in an access token as the Bearer value in your authorization header.
OAuth 2.0 is the right choice for multi-user integrations, SaaS products, or anything where you're acting on behalf of other people's Smartsheet accounts.
You need a Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management plan
API access is not available on the free tier or self-serve Pro plan

result.notes: API access requires minimum Business plan subscription ($24.19/user/month). Free tier and Pro plans do not include API access. OAuth 2.0 and API key (bearer token) authentication are supported. Exact endpoint count unknown from available documentation.
